tests.name: Hindsight 1.2.1 static render
tests.command: kustomize build --enable-helm k8s/optional/personal-ai-2026/hindsight; kubeconform -strict -ignore-missing-schemas
tests.reason: The corrective official chart rendered 11 resources with 1 valid, 0 invalid and 10 CRD-backed resources skipped.

tests.name: Hindsight corrective PR admission
tests.command: GitHub PR #1164 required checks
tests.reason: docs-required, v1-contract and workflow-integrity passed; the independent CodeRabbit observation was corrected before merge.

tests.name: Exact Hindsight Doppler plan and apply
tests.command: doppler run --project infrastructure --config prd -- bash scripts/live-tofu.sh plan|apply doppler <saved-plan>
tests.reason: The saved plan contained exactly four Hindsight creates, no other action, and was applied without recalculation; state serial advanced 58 to 59 with unchanged lineage.

tests.name: Doppler state drift check
tests.command: doppler run --project infrastructure --config prd -- bash scripts/live-tofu.sh plan doppler
tests.reason: The post-apply plan returned no actions and both Hindsight Doppler key names were present without reading values.

tests.name: Hindsight ExternalSecrets
tests.command: kubectl -n hindsight-personal get externalsecret
tests.reason: hindsight-cnpg-s3, hindsight-db-bootstrap and hindsight-runtime were SecretSynced=True and Ready.

tests.name: Hindsight Argo reconciliation
tests.command: just status-app personal-hindsight
tests.reason: personal-hindsight reported Synced/Healthy with revision 1.2.1 and operation Succeeded.

tests.name: Hindsight CNPG pgvector runtime
tests.command: kubectl exec hindsight-db-1 -- psql; kubectl get pod,pvc
tests.reason: The source pod was 2/2 Running, both Longhorn PVCs were Bound, and SQL confirmed pgvector; CNPG also exposes a pre-existing status-extraction condition, which remains recorded.

tests.name: Hindsight CNPG backup
tests.command: kubectl get backup.postgresql.cnpg.io hindsight-db-initial-20261110
tests.reason: The plugin backup completed with backup ID 20261110T142602.

tests.name: Hindsight retain recall reflect correction
tests.command: private port-forward; POST memories, recall and reflect
tests.reason: Synthetic isolated bank: retain 200, recall 200 with results, correction by document replacement, and reflect 200 after 1.2.1.

tests.name: Hindsight API restart persistence
tests.command: kubectl rollout restart deployment/hindsight-api; recall after rollout
tests.reason: The API rollout completed and the corrected synthetic memory was recalled with HTTP 200 afterward.

tests.name: Hindsight isolated CNPG restore
tests.command: Argo recovery cluster; recovery job; isolated SQL checks
tests.reason: The recovery job succeeded, the new pod and PVCs were usable, and SQL confirmed hindsight/vector/25 tables/2 synthetic rows; no HTTPRoute or application writer exists.

tests.name: Repository required check suite
tests.command: just check
tests.reason: The existing aiostreams staged family-http-route contract failure remains outside PLT-165; it is not converted into a pass.

tests.name: Existing cluster backup audit
tests.command: just backup-audit
tests.reason: The shared baseline still reports pre-existing coverage and restore-proof gaps; Hindsight-specific backup and restore evidence is recorded separately above.

tests.name: OpenClaw two-session Hindsight journey
tests.command: OpenClaw conversation A, new session B, recall and correction
tests.reason: OpenClaw remains unadmitted pending its own plugin, Cilium, resource, session and user-level qualification PR.

tests.name: LibreChat Authentik two-user isolation
tests.command: two-user OIDC login and cross-user denial journey
tests.reason: LibreChat remains fail-closed and unadmitted; Authentik OIDC, MongoDB restore and cross-user denial are not yet proven.
